rows.grounds: kṛsara = a dish of rice and pulses; ritual offering item in verse 8290
compound śarkarā-yukta = joined with śarkarā (sugar); describes kṛsaraṃ
sa-ārdraka = together with ārdraka (fresh ginger); describes kṛsaraṃ
compound go-ghṛta-pluta = flooded/soaked in go-ghṛta (cow ghee); describes kṛsaraṃ
